$comment: The stage-pipeline permission profile. Read by scripts/permissions.mjs. Skill(...) and mcp__* entries are not listed — they are generated from the plugin itself (skills/*, .mcp.json), so a new skill does not have to be added here by hand. Bash(...) is a PREFIX match: the space before * is literal, so "Bash(rm -rf dist *)" does not cover "rm -rf dist", and "Bash(curl -s http://localhost *)" does not cover "curl -s http://localhost:3000/". deny here is protection against accidents, not a security boundary: the profile allows node/npx/python3, which is arbitrary execution, and bypassing any prohibition from it is trivial.

pipeline.title: Plugin skills and MCP
pipeline.why: Without this every checker asks for confirmation at every stage — the most frequent source of idle time

fs-read.title: Reading and search
fs-read.why: Checkers and spec agents read the whole repo; a confirmation per file makes a run unworkable. The group holds only what neither writes nor runs foreign commands

shell-tools.title: Text processing and tree traversal (they write and run)
shell-tools.why: Checkers need them for search and edits, but this is NOT read-only: sed -i writes a file, find -exec / xargs / awk system() run an arbitrary command. A separate group so that --groups without it gives an honestly read-only set

fs-write.title: File edits and build artifact cleanup
fs-write.why: Stage implementation and the fix-loop write code; deletion is only of the listed build artifacts by exact name. A bare "rm -f *" must not be here: a prefix match would let through "rm -f -r <any path>"

vcs.title: Git (except publishing commands)
vcs.why: The stage diff, merge-base, stash for the baseline measurement, the stage commit. push / reset --hard / clean stay in ask, force-push in deny

js-toolchain.title: Package managers and local binaries
js-toolchain.why: lint / type-check / tests / build run at every stage and in the checkers

devserver.title: Dev server and local ports
devserver.why: devtools-verify needs a live server: find the process, check the port, stop its own instance. curl is only for localhost/127.0.0.1; pkill by mask is in ask, because it kills more than your own

docker.title: Docker (optional)
docker.why: Needed only by projects whose dev environment is brought up by containers

web.title: Search and docs (optional)
web.why: Checking against framework documentation during review; the list of domains is narrow

retired.$comment: Entries the profile used to hand out and that the script has no right to remove (settings belong to the user). It finds them and explains why they should be removed by hand.
retired.mcp__plugin_stage-pipeline_context7: Context7 was removed from the plugin in 0.11.0 — there is no server with that name any more, the entry refers to nothing
retired.Bash(rm -f *): allows "rm -f -r <any path>": a prefix match does not look at the order of flags
retired.Bash(rm -rf .next *): requires an argument AFTER .next — does not cover "rm -rf .next", but does cover "rm -rf .next /someone/elses/path"
retired.Bash(pkill -f *): moved to ask: the mask kills more than your own dev server
retired.Bash(curl -s http://localhost *): the space before * is literal — does not cover "curl -s http://localhost:3000/"
